items.period: Han Shuowen seal-script model; digital image uploaded 2016
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of 本 in the seal-script style associated with Shuowen. The lower cross-stroke marks the base of 木 in the traditional root analysis.
items.alt: Square black seal-script-style character with a tree-like 木 form and a horizontal stroke crossing its lower trunk.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description explicitly identifies the graph as 本 in Shuowen seal style and cites paleographic databases; its form illustrates the placement of the semantic mark. It is a redraw, not an ancient artifact image.
items.rights: Public domain release stated on Commons file page.

limitations.text: No proposed artifact photograph or securely attributable bronze image could be established in this search. The one candidate is a modern redraw; its visual pixels were not inspected, so the caption and alt remain description-based pending visual review.
